findings.title: Optimizer throughput is not network TPS evidence
findings.evidence: Runner computes tx/sec from number of compiler samples divided by compile time. It measures compiler/optimizer throughput, not mempool-to-finality transaction rate.

findings.scenario: Reusing these numbers as blockchain TPS would mislead capacity planning and sponsor claims.
